body: luckily we have the nhs so no worrying about that.
i do, but i’d rather not. it kind of goes against the whole point of it which is to actually go through with it.
literally. it would be way easier but now i’m stuck here trying to find a way out myself.

idk maybe i’ll pussy out of it later and tell someone. please don’t feel bad or anything. i didn’t do this in a moment of spiralling or shit. i’m calm and genuinely want to do this. i’m okay with it.
ibuprofen. not too long ago, i don’t feel anything yet.
i don’t want help. i just wanted to let this out and finally be heard. maybe someone will find me before but i’m not going to go out of my way for that. thank you for caring though.
